audience: astrology content creators on Instagram and YouTube
subject: VedicHour partnership idea
body:
Hi [First name],

I’ve been following [their work] and like the thoughtful way you make astrology approachable.

I’m reaching out from VedicHour, a calm Jyotish timing tool that rates all 18 planetary hours, uses Swiss Ephemeris + Lahiri ayanamsa, and explains the day in plain English.

Would you be open to a simple creator partnership? We can offer you a free Pro account, a custom audience code like PARTNERNAME10, and a revenue share on paid reports.

No pressure or hype. Just a useful timing-awareness resource your audience can try alongside your content.

Your Life, Decoded Hour by Hour.

To unsubscribe, reply “unsubscribe.” [Physical address]
linter_reason: Slogan 'Your Life, Decoded' implies certainty, not just awareness or reflection.
